description.en: Clears every forced-win entry previously set with CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_WIN, for every team/player at once.
Always null — the native implementation never pushes a value onto the stack on success; null is also returned if the call was invalid.

example.code:
// Clear all forced-win entries once the scripted sequence is done
CMND_BTL_RESET_FORCE_WIN();
